The '''Azure system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Azure/Legends|Azure]].
